Avengers Endgame: Encore returns to theaters Friday 🍿🔥

🎥🎬: Avengers: Endgame

After Thanos erases half of all life in the universe, the surviving Avengers struggle to move forward. Years later, Scott Lang emerges from the Quantum Realm with an idea that could give them one final opportunity to reverse the devastation.

The Avengers reunite and travel through time to recover the Infinity Stones, revisiting crucial moments from their past while risking everything to restore those they lost. But bringing everyone back means facing consequences none of them could have anticipated.

Their mission ultimately leads to an enormous final battle against Thanos and his army, forcing Earth’s mightiest heroes to make sacrifices that will forever change the Avengers and the universe.
